audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Elihu continues: claim to speak for God, divine justice, discipline through affliction, warning against ransom/anger, and transition into divine greatness over rain, clouds, thunder, and light.

verses.restored: Elihu continued and said:

familiar.text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.restored: Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for there are still words for the Divine.

familiar.text: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.

verses.restored: I will lift my knowledge from afar and give righteousness to my Maker.

familiar.text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.restored: For truly my words are not false; one complete in knowledge is with you.

familiar.text: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

verses.restored: Look, the Divine is mighty and does not reject; mighty in strength of heart.

familiar.text: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

verses.restored: He does not preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

familiar.text: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

verses.restored: He does not withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he seats them forever, and they are exalted.

familiar.text: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.restored: If they are bound in chains, caught in cords of affliction,

familiar.text: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.restored: then he tells them their work and their transgressions, that they have acted proudly.

familiar.text: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

verses.restored: He opens their ear to instruction and says that they should turn back from harm.

familiar.text: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.restored: If they listen and serve, they complete their days in good and their years in pleasantness.

familiar.text: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.restored: But if they do not listen, they pass through the weapon and expire without knowledge.

familiar.text: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.restored: The godless in heart store up anger; they do not cry for help when he binds them.

familiar.text: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

verses.restored: Their soul dies in youth, and their life among the shameful.

familiar.text: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

verses.restored: He rescues the afflicted through their affliction and opens their ear through pressure.

familiar.text: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

verses.restored: Indeed, he would have drawn you out from the mouth of distress to a broad place with no constraint, and what is set on your table would be full of fatness.

familiar.text: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

verses.restored: But you are full of the judgment of the wicked; judgment and justice take hold.

familiar.text: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

verses.restored: Beware lest wrath entice you into scoffing, and do not let a great ransom turn you aside.

familiar.text: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

verses.restored: Will your cry for help arrange you beyond distress, or all the forces of strength?

familiar.text: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

verses.restored: Do not long for the night, when peoples are taken up from their place.

familiar.text: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.restored: Guard yourself; do not turn to harm, for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

familiar.text: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.restored: Look, the Divine is exalted in his power; who is a teacher like him?

familiar.text: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

verses.restored: Who has appointed his way for him, or who has said, You have done wrong?

familiar.text: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

verses.restored: Remember to magnify his work, of which people have sung.

familiar.text: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

verses.restored: All humanity has seen it; a mortal beholds it from afar.

familiar.text: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

verses.restored: Look, the Divine is great, and we do not know him; the number of his years is beyond searching.

familiar.text: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

verses.restored: For he draws up drops of water; they distill rain from his mist,

familiar.text: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

verses.restored: which the clouds pour down; they drip upon humanity abundantly.

familiar.text: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

verses.restored: Can anyone understand the spreadings of the clouds, the thunderings of his pavilion?

familiar.text: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

verses.restored: Look, he spreads his light around him and covers the roots of the sea.

familiar.text: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

verses.restored: For by these he judges peoples; he gives food in abundance.

familiar.text: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

verses.restored: He covers his hands with lightning and commands it against the target.

familiar.text: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

verses.restored: His thunder declares concerning him; the livestock also, concerning what rises.

familiar.text: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
